question.text: The correct order of viscosity of the following liquids will be :

options.text: Water $ < $ methyl alcohol $ < $ dimethyl ether $ < $ glycerol
methyl alcohol $ < $ glycerol $ < $ water $ < $ dimethyl ether
dimethyl ether $ < $ methyl alcohol $ < $ water $ < $ glycerol
glycerol $ < $ dimethyl ether $ < $ water $ < $ methyl alcohol

solution.text: The correct order of viscosity of the given liquids is dimethyl ether $ < $ methyl alcohol $ < $ water $ < $ glycerol.
